QUOTE: "Inside the library: nothing. The index finds no thread spawn in `library/`. Its four spawn sites are all in `programs/`" and "the default build does not compile it."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads and the pthread server isn't compiled by default, but it doesn't conclude that a default build creates no threads at all. It also never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main, and it lists the program spawn sites as existing.
